summary: Medicus Pharma Ltd. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Co-Development and License Agreement with Pfizer Inc. on September 2, 2026. Pfizer granted Medicus an exclusive worldwide license to develop and commercialize CD228V, an antibody-drug conjugate, under a co-development structure. Consideration includes a $12M upfront payment from Medicus to Pfizer, an additional $15M due in one year, and Pfizer contributing development funding. This is a routine licensing agreement, not a special situation. What to watch: development milestones and regulatory progress.
